name: sign-se-pehle
description: Sign Se Pehle — understand any Indian legal document before you sign it. Gemini-powered plain-language explanations, law-anchored red flags, what-if consequences and lawyer-ready briefs. Information, not legal advice.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @sign-se-pehle/web && npm run build -w @sign-se-pehle/server
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @sign-se-pehle/server" "npm run dev -w @sign-se-pehle/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @sign-se-pehle/core && npm run test -w @sign-se-pehle/server && npm run test -w @sign-se-pehle/web
scripts.test:server: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @sign-se-pehle/server
scripts.test:web: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @sign-se-pehle/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:core && npm run test:coverage --workspaces
scripts.type-check: npm run build:core && npm run type-check --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
